new_skills.name: ci-cd
new_skills.description: Set up automated Snowflake deploys with CI/CD pipelines and OIDC authentication on GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps. Use whenever the user wants to automate Snowflake deploys, deploy on push or PR merge, validate on PR / merge request, configure pipeline authentication, or unblock CI from a Snowflake network policy (e.g. allow GitHub Actions / GitLab / Azure DevOps runners through a network policy, recommend a managed network rule for CI runners, IP-allowlist hosted runners).
